title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Schedule of Holiday Hours by the Latest Certified Week
content:
For a holiday-pay report on Unemployment Benefit Claims, the holiday hours valued follow the hours reported on the latest certified week — the certification with the latest week ending date — of the claimant's most recent earlier claim of the same program.

| Hours reported on the latest certified week | Holiday hours |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 12 (the short-week hours) | 4 |
| At least 12 but fewer than 24 (the mid-week hours) | 6 |
| At least 24 | 8 (the standard holiday hours) |

## Boundary cases

| Hours on the latest certified week | Holiday hours |
|---|---|
| 11.5 | 4 |
| 12.0 | 6 |
| 23.5 | 6 |
| 24.0 | 8 |
